description: This file defines an abstract class 'StreamBatchingTestRunner' used for testing streaming behavior in Orleans. It contains test methods for sending and consuming message batches via streams, utilizing Xunit for testing and custom attributes for test control. The class interacts with Orleans stream providers, grains, and testing utilities to verify batching behavior.

classes.name: StreamBatchingTestRunner
classes.description: An abstract class providing streaming batch test methods for Orleans, utilizing Xunit testing framework. Contains setup, test methods for batch sending/receiving, and a utility method for verification.

methods.name: SingleSendBatchConsume
methods.description: Test method that sends individual messages to a stream and verifies consumption and batching behavior.

methods.name: BatchSendSingleConsume
methods.description: Test method that sends batches of messages to a stream and verifies total consumption.

methods.name: BatchSendBatchConsume
methods.description: Test method that sends batches of messages and verifies batch consumption and maximum batch size.

methods.name: CheckCounters
methods.description: Utility method that fetches consumption reports from a grain and asserts expected consumption and batch size constraints.
